issue_context.title: Skip collecting statistics for some wide column types such as JSON/TEXT/BLOB
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Currenly, analyze would collect about 11000 samples into TiDB memory. If the table has some wide column types such JSON/TEXT/BLOB, the samples can take up much memory and even lead to OOM. However, the statistics collected for JSON/BLOB are not very important since the optimizer rarely use them. Hence, we hope to skip collecting statistics for some wide column types such as JSON/TEXT/BLOB.

review_comments: The background auto-analyze goroutine's `sctx` is initialized at the beginning, so can it read the latest variable value here?
It will not impact the column list persisted in analyze_options, right?
Why do we add this validation? It seems that all types should be allowed to skip.
For caution, we constrain the column types which can be skipped to `json,blob,mediumblob,longblob,text,mediumntext,longtext`.
Skipping a int-type column doesn't have much benefit but accidentally `set tidb_analyze_skip_column_types = 'int'` may bring some trouble.
